premise.claim: Installing multiple Fluid Helm releases in different namespaces fails: "Unable to continue with install: ClusterRole \"alluxioruntime-controller\" in namespace \"\" exists and cannot be imported into the current release: invalid ownership metadata"
premise.patchedComponent: Same RBAC templates + upgrade/crd-upgrade.yaml (matches for the RBAC subset only; CSIDriver and MutatingWebhookConfiguration are also part of the reported symptom and are NOT patched)
premise.evidence: Base render f432bdc: 26 cluster-scoped collisions across two releases incl. ClusterRole/alluxioruntime-controller (results/base-f432bdc.txt)

findings.title: Second Fluid release still fails with the #6134 ownership error: CSIDriver fuse.csi.fluid.io and MutatingWebhookConfiguration fluid-pod-admission-webhook keep fixed names
Same release name in two namespaces still collides on all 26 cluster-scoped objects (fluid.fullname ignores .Release.Namespace)
Guard/control: RBAC renaming works (green on PR head, red on base) — keep green, red means the PR's own fix regressed
